Engineers India Limited (EIL) has announced a recruitment drive for 109 positions including Associate Engineers and Officers for its domestic and foreign construction projects. According to the available notification details, applications are processed online through the official EIL portal.

Notification and Vacancy Overview

  • Issuing Authority: Engineers India Limited (EIL)
  • Notification ID / Advertisement Number: HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/11
  • Total Vacancies: 109 posts
  • Posts Offered: Associate Engineer (Grades II, III, IV) and Associate Officer (Grades II, etc.)

Eligibility and Age Criteria

  • Educational Qualifications: Varies by post, generally requiring BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engineering) in relevant branches like Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, or diplomas with specialized management qualifications as specified in the official notice.
  • Experience: Ranges from 5 to 14 years depending on the specific grade.
  • Age Limit & Cut-off Date: Age and experience are calculated as of September 30, 2026, with maximum age limits varying between 37 and 45 years depending on the post.

Important Dates and Fees

  • Application Start Date: October 19, 2026
  • Application Last Date: November 2, 2026
  • Application Fee: Not specified

Selection Stages and Salary

  • Selection Process: Direct walk-in interview without a written exam. Shortlisted candidates receive details via registered email regarding interview venue, date, and time.
  • Interview Locations: Designated EIL offices in Gurugram, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata.
  • Tenure: Fixed-term basis for 2 years, extendable by up to 1 year based on requirements.
  • Salary Range: Varies by grade, approximately between ₹72,000 to ₹1,12,000/- per month as reported.

How to Apply and Verify

  1. Visit the official website at recruitment.eil.co.in or engineersindia.com.
  2. Navigate to the careers section to find the active recruitment link.
  3. Fill out the online application form, upload scanned photographs and signatures in the prescribed size, and take a printout of the submitted form.
  4. Attach self-attested documents and a colored photograph to the printed form to present during the walk-in interview.

Candidates are advised to review the official notification thoroughly on the authorized website before applying or attending interviews.
